nodes.description: HER performance and stability of FeOOH/Ru-FeNi MOF@NF
nodes.source_text: It is evident that the explicit improvement of the overall current density from FeOOH/Ru-FeNi MOFs... The stability of HER performance in FeOOH/Ru-FeNi MOFs... exhibits exceptional durability, with minimal decay in current density values of less than 3% after 1000 polarization-curve scans. Notably, the catalyst displays remarkable stability at 100 mA cm⁻² for over 18000 s... The resulting Faradaic efficiencies at current densities of 100 mA cm⁻² and 10 mA cm⁻² are estimated to be 94.60% and 92.70%, respectively.

The tests are performed with six cycles, where the volumes of H₂ and O₂ generation are separately recorded. The slopes displaying in the correlation between gas volume and time are found to be 2:1, corresponding to the stoichiometric volume ratio of water-splitting expression (H₂O → H₂ + 1/2 O₂).

nodes.characterization_summary: Top-view SEM images show morphology of Ni MOFs and FeNi MOFs with uniform elemental distribution confirmed by EDS mapping.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. S1 Top-view SEM images of (a) Ni MOFs and (b) FeNi MOFs synthesized with one-pot precipitation processes. The inset figures show the correlated EDS mapping results, indicating the uniform formation of Ni MOFs and FeNI MOFs, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM image and EDS mappings of staggered FeNi MOFs show uniform distributions of Fe and Ni constituents.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. S2 Representative TEM image and correlated elemental EDS mappings of staggered FeNi MOFs, showing the uniform distributions of Fe and Ni constitutes, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: FeNi MOFs XPS shows C 1s peaks at 284.8 eV (C=C), 286.2 eV (C-O), 288.8 eV (C-O=C); O 1s at 530.8 eV and 532.0 eV; Ni 2p Ni(2+) at 855.0 eV, 873.2 eV and Ni(1+) at 859.6 eV, 874.5 eV; Fe 2p at 709.0 eV and 722.6 eV. Ni 2p shows blue shift in FeNi MOFs vs Ni MOFs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The elemental compositions and chemical features of various MOF structures are investigated, as shown in Fig. S3. In C 1s spectrum, three distinct peaks are observed... By comparing the spectral features of Ni 2p from FeNi MOFs and Ni MOFs, the explicit blue shifts of correlated Ni 2p patterns in FeNi MOF relative to those of Ni MOFs are evidenced.
